title: Life expectancy summary (real CC-BY prose from Our World in Data)

source.attribution: Our World in Data (Roser, Ortiz-Ospina, Ritchie), CC-BY-4.0
source.notes: Composed from real Our World in Data figures (CC-BY): newborn life expectancy 32 years in 1900 rising to 71 by 2021 (more than doubled); global average just over 70 in 2021, less than half that two hundred years ago; in 2021 Nigeria's life expectancy was thirty years lower than Japan's (Japan close to 85). Figures verified consistent (32 to 71 is ~2.2x; less than half of 70 is under 35; 85 minus 30 is 55) before injecting 3 defects.
